title: First special sitting of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/20/2025/ޚޞ/1).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for Vice President of the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives, under Article 8(a) of the Human Rights Commission Act (Law No. 6/2006), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

From the Speaker's desk: the names of four Cabinet ministers appointed by the President on 26 December 2024 under Article 129(a) of the Constitution, submitted for the Majlis's consent under Article 129(d), are sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission for appointing two members to the Anti-Corruption Commission, under Article 200(b) of the Constitution and Article 4(n) of the Anti-Corruption Commission Act (Law No. 13/2008), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on its review of the President's nominations for appointing two members to the Maldives Broadcasting Commission under Article 6(b) of the Broadcasting Act (Law No. 16/2010).

Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on its review of the President's nominations for appointing two members to the Elections Commission under Article 4(b) of the Elections Commission Act (Law No. 8/2008).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The first special sitting of 2025 was scheduled to send a Human Rights Commission vice president, four new Cabinet ministers and two Anti-Corruption Commission nominees to committee, and to vote on committee reports on Broadcasting Commission and Elections Commission appointments.
